title: 前后脚慢慢站
description: 成人在平地采用舒适前后脚站姿，双臂轻展开。

art_direction.medium: fine pen and transparent watercolor on warm paper
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult stands in a comfortable narrow staggered stance on a level gym floor, one foot slightly ahead of the other without a tight heel-to-toe demand. Both arms open gently to the sides and the gaze stays forward. A fixed rail appears at the edge of the frame for an easy support option. Show the feet clearly and keep the shoulders relaxed, with generous empty space around the body. Use layered cardboard diorama illustration with folded architectural planes, readable joints, small material shadows, and beige, aqua, and orange accents. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
